        COALESCE(oe.total_extras, 0) as total_extras,
        cr.cancellation,
        pizza_price + total_extras as income
    FROM pizza_customer_orders co
    LEFT JOIN order_extras_total oe ON co.order_id = oe.order_id
    LEFT JOIN pizza_runner_orders cr ON co.order_id = cr.order_id
    WHERE cr.cancellation IS NULL OR cr.cancellation = ''
)
SELECT 
    pizza_id,
    pizza_price,
    total_extras,
    income,
    COUNT(*) as row_count
FROM order_info

GROUP BY pizza_id, pizza_price, total_extras, income
ORDER BY pizza_id, total_extras
